get.summary: Which products have files to download
get.description: For a product page that says "Instant download". Keyed by product id; a product with no files, or not active, is absent. Names and sizes are not given.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Up to 100 product ids, separated by commas.

get.description: For whoever holds the order's access token. Empty until the order is paid. Each download has a status: ready, expired, used_up or revoked. A wrong token answers 404.

404.description: No such order for this token.

post.summary: A fresh link to one download
post.description: Mints a link that lasts ten minutes and replaces any earlier one for this download. The first request on it counts one download; asking again on the same link does not count again. 410 with code download_revoked, download_expired or download_limit_reached when the file can no longer be had.

404.description: No such order for this token, or no such download on it.

get.description: The bytes, as an attachment, with range support. 410 download_link_expired once the link has run out; the other 410 codes as above.

410.description: The link or the download is closed.

get.summary: A product's files and its download rule

post.description: Requires catalog.write. Multipart: file, and optionally variant_id for a file only that variant's buyers get. At most 100 MB. Kept in the database, never at a public address.

400.description: No file, an empty one, or one too big.

put.summary: Set a product's download limit and expiry
put.description: Requires catalog.write. {"download_limit": 5, "expiry_days": 30}; null for no limit or never. Applies to orders paid from now on.

get.summary: Download a file as a buyer would get it

put.description: Requires catalog.write. Multipart, as upload. Keeps the file's id, so everyone who bought it gets the new version.

delete.description: Requires catalog.write. Every buyer loses access to it.

get.description: Requires orders.read. As the buyer sees them, with why a revoked one was closed.

post.description: Requires orders.write. Clears a revoke, sets the count back to zero, and gives an expired one seven more days.
